_note: Baseline of app-local CSS component-class families (first hyphen segment of classes DEFINED in each app's own css). The frontend canon guard (#1421) fails when an app grows a NEW family: new UI belongs in the reference + @digithings/ui first (packages/ui/MIGRATION.md). To extend deliberately, add the prefix here in the same PR with a justifying comment in that PR's body.
_dq: dashboard .dq-slab is the BLEND v0.1 tonal slab (surface + hairline, radius 0) that replaced the retired .glass-card family. MotionLayer reveals .dq-slab.
_acct: dashboard .acct-* is the digiweb account family (login, signup, session, settings) born in apps/reference/app/account/account.css. dashboard consumes the same prefix rather than forking a local one (PR #3264).
_dboot: digithings-web .dboot-* is the @digithings/ui digichat boot-loader family (packages/ui/src/styles/digichat-boot-loader.css); the site shell overrides one dock rule for the wide composer (ChatEmbedShell); same precedent as .tl-*.
_digichat_2_0: digichat 2.0 assistant-ui product CSS: .aui-* (stock Thread chrome) and .dark-* (theme variants). Added with the 2.0.0 cut (#3629); not a new app-local family.
_stack: digithings-web .stack-* is the /variants/mixed stack showcase (branch claude/home-variants): the bento grid as a map with a travelling focus, pinned by .stack-pin and dimmed per .stack-cell.is-active. Exploration only — if the showcase is picked it moves into @digithings/ui (data-layout styles + component + tests) and this entry is deleted with the app block.
_faq: digithings-web .faq-morph* is the #faq band's scroll-driven zoom-morph (branch claude/home-variants): the chat container starts large over the frame and retracts into the right column as the FAQ list rises in on the left (#4429). Same shape and same status as the .stack-* family — the pinned track and sticky pin live in the app sheet because the geometry is this band's own two-column grid; if the owner picks the morph it promotes into @digithings/ui and this entry is deleted with the app block.
_why: why — the throwaway /variants/why page (#4429): `whyx*` (the rented/owned stack composition and its two swap treatments) and `why-ledger*` (the benefit ledger). App-local because the page is an exploration: when one is picked it folds into Argument.tsx and the classes move into the band's markup or @digithings/ui.
_whyx: whyx — the rented-vs-owned stack composition on the throwaway /variants/why page (#4429): the two diagrams, the ten-step rail and the lateral swap. App-local because the page is an exploration; on a pick it folds into Argument.tsx and the classes move into the band's markup or @digithings/ui.
